hunks.baseline: I don't know how much time had passed.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know how much time had passed.

hunks.baseline: My time moved infinitely slowly, while the Western Heaven Demon Lord's passed as quickly and violently as the current of the Yangtze I had seen a few weeks ago.
hunks.sol: Time crawled for me, while the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s rushed by as swift and violent as the Yangtze’s current I had seen a few weeks ago.

hunks.baseline: One thing was certain: even now, at this very moment, time was passing.
hunks.sol: One thing was certain: even now, at this very moment, time kept moving.

hunks.baseline: I failed to see either his preparatory movement or his actual motion. By the time I realized the Western Heaven Demon Lord had taken a step, my head had already snapped backward.
hunks.sol: I saw neither a windup nor the movement itself. By the time I realized the Western Heaven Demon Lord had taken a step, my head had already snapped back.

hunks.baseline: A palm strike and a punch infused with internal energy flowed over my upper body like water.
hunks.sol: Palm and fist, each laden with internal energy, hammered my upper body in fluid succession.

hunks.baseline: Through the agony and the white haze filling my vision as my bones shifted, I gritted my teeth.
hunks.sol: My bones shifted with sickening cracks, and agony washed my vision white. I gritted my teeth.

hunks.baseline: One of my molars shattered, and for a brief moment, my mind cleared.
hunks.sol: A molar shattered, and for a brief moment, my mind cleared.

hunks.baseline: With a cry squeezed out from the depths of my lungs, I swung my fist.
hunks.sol: With a cry squeezed from the depths of my lungs, I swung my fist.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord caught the fist riddled with openings and slow beyond belief, then clicked his tongue.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord caught my hopelessly slow, wide-open punch and clicked his tongue.

hunks.baseline: His hand, curled like a hook, seized my wrist and twisted. Flesh and bone shattered together.
hunks.sol: His hook-like hand seized my wrist and twisted. Flesh and bone were crushed together.

hunks.baseline: The bones in my left arm, which had already been broken once, splintered into pieces, sending horrific pain through me.
hunks.sol: The bones in my already broken left arm splintered, sending horrific pain through me.

hunks.baseline: “Do not worry. I will call some skilled healers to treat you later.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t worry. I’ll summon some skilled healers to treat you later.”

hunks.baseline: I thrust out my still-usable right arm at the Western Heaven Demon Lord, who was wiping the blood splashed across his face.
hunks.sol: I thrust my still-usable right arm at the Western Heaven Demon Lord as he wiped the blood splattered across his face.

hunks.baseline: The spearhead of White Flame, wrapped in a faint Spear Energy, stabbed toward his lower body.
hunks.sol: White Flame’s spearhead, wreathed in faint Spear Energy, stabbed toward his lower body.

hunks.baseline: Screech. Clang.
hunks.sol: Whoosh. Clack.

hunks.baseline: But the spearhead was blocked with absurd ease.
hunks.sol: But the spearhead was stopped with absurd ease.

hunks.baseline: Not by the Black Dragon Armor or Body-Protecting Qi.
hunks.sol: Not by the Black Dragon Armor or Body-Protecting Qi, but by the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s bare hand.

hunks.baseline: By the Western Heaven Demon Lord's hand.

hunks.baseline: His hand, wrapped in ink-colored Force, tightened around the spearhead. The energy that had been dimly gathering disappeared as though swallowed by darkness.
hunks.sol: His hand, wrapped in ink-black Force, tightened around the spearhead. The faint energy gathered there vanished as though swallowed by darkness.

hunks.baseline: “Give up. The outcome will not change anyway.”
hunks.sol: “Give up. The outcome won’t change.”

hunks.baseline: With a quiet voice, the Western Heaven Demon Lord pulled on the spearhead.
hunks.sol: With those quiet words, the Western Heaven Demon Lord yanked on the spearhead.

hunks.baseline: I stubbornly clung to the shaft as it tried to slip from my flayed, blood-soaked grip.
hunks.sol: I clung desperately to the shaft as it tried to slip from my flayed, blood-soaked grip.

hunks.baseline: A searing pain surged through me, but it was bearable.
hunks.sol: Searing pain surged through me, but it was bearable.

hunks.baseline: I had endured more than enough pain in the past—and in the present.
hunks.sol: Pain was something I’d endured more than enough of, both in the past and now.

hunks.baseline: I tumbled forward with the spear shaft. A handful of dirt entered my mouth and mixed with the blood.
hunks.sol: I pitched forward with the spear shaft. A mouthful of dirt mixed with the blood already coating my tongue.

hunks.baseline: The ice-cold, foul-smelling floor of the underground prison felt strangely more comfortable than ever.
hunks.sol: The ice-cold, foul-smelling floor of the underground prison somehow felt more comfortable than ever.

hunks.baseline: *I'm sleepy.*
hunks.sol: *I’m sleepy.*

hunks.baseline: After sleeping through a long dream that lasted for days, perhaps I would wake up not in the Murim but in the modern world.
hunks.sol: Maybe after dreaming one long dream for days on end, I would wake up in the modern world instead of Murim.

hunks.baseline: A soft seat on a private plane headed for Sichuan, China, would be fine. So would the one-room at Hope Goshiwon, with its lingering smell of a stale bachelor.[^1]
hunks.sol: A plush seat on a private plane bound for Sichuan, China, would be fine. So would my room at Hope Goshiwon, steeped in the musty smell of a bachelor living alone.[^1]

hunks.baseline: In the more than year I had spent here, I had gone through too much.
hunks.sol: I had been through too much in the space of little more than a year.

hunks.baseline: From F-rank Hunter Jin Taekyung to the Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan. From a disgrace who brought shame to his family name to the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi.
hunks.sol: From F-rank Hunter Jin Taekyung to the Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan. From a disgrace who dragged his family’s name through the mud to the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi.

hunks.baseline: I had witnessed horrific wars and countless deaths. I had met so many people.
hunks.sol: I had witnessed brutal wars and countless deaths. I had met so many people.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung, who absolutely doted on his younger brother, and Jin Mukyung, who would have loved to kill his. Hyuk Mujin, who had shared life and death with me while always remaining at my side. Cheongpung, who was both my friend and my rival.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung, who doted on his youngest brother, and Jin Mukyung, who seemed to want his youngest brother dead. Hyuk Mujin, who had shared life and death with me and always remained by my side. Cheongpung, both my friend and my rival.

hunks.baseline: My eyelids, which had been slowly closing without my realizing it, stopped.
hunks.sol: My eyelids, which had been slowly sliding shut without my realizing it, stopped.

hunks.baseline: That's right. The Fire King, Jeok Cheongang.
hunks.sol: That was right. The Fire King, Jeok Cheongang.

hunks.baseline: He was behind me, and I was in front of him.
hunks.sol: He was behind me, and I stood before him.

hunks.baseline: That was why I could not fall. I could not run away.
hunks.sol: That was why I could neither fall nor run away.

hunks.baseline: *That insolent bastard. Taekyung, go on ahead.*
hunks.sol: *That arrogant bastard. Taekyung, go on ahead.*

hunks.baseline: *I'll catch up soon.*
hunks.sol: *I’ll catch up soon.*

hunks.baseline: *How about it? Dance of the Fire God and Demon. Isn't it incredible?*
hunks.sol: *What do you think? The Dance of the Fire God and Demon. Pretty damn incredible, isn’t it?*

hunks.baseline: That smile held the joy of avenging his closest friend—and the relief of protecting one little brat he couldn't tell was his disciple or his enemy.
hunks.sol: That smile held the joy of avenging his dearest friend—and the relief of protecting one little brat who might as well have been either his disciple or his mortal enemy.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. It's incredible…”
hunks.sol: “Yes. It’s incredible…”

hunks.baseline: A small voice leaked through my torn and swollen lips.
hunks.sol: A small voice escaped through my torn, swollen lips.

hunks.baseline: At some point, the floor of the underground prison no longer felt comfortable.
hunks.sol: The floor of the underground prison no longer felt comfortable.

hunks.baseline: Feeling its unpleasant cold and stench, I began to raise myself.
hunks.sol: Feeling its bitter cold and stench, I began to push myself up.

hunks.baseline: I planted my still-usable right arm on the floor and supported myself on both knees.
hunks.sol: I braced my still-usable right arm against the floor and supported myself on both knees.

hunks.baseline: My body felt as though it might break apart at any moment, and my movements were slow, but I did not give up.
hunks.sol: My body felt ready to break apart at any moment, and every movement was slow, but I refused to give up.

hunks.baseline: When I finally stood upright on my trembling legs, the first thing I encountered was a pair of deeply sunken eyes.
hunks.sol: When I finally stood on my trembling legs, the first thing I met was a pair of dark, solemn eyes.

hunks.baseline: “Impressive. To the point of looking foolish.”
hunks.sol: “Impressive. Almost foolishly so.”

hunks.baseline: My nose broke, and my head snapped backward. But I did not fall or stagger back.
hunks.sol: My nose broke, snapping my head back. But I neither fell nor staggered away.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord's hand had seized my shoulder like a shackle.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s hand held my shoulder like a shackle.

hunks.baseline: “How many times must I tell you? It is already over.”
hunks.sol: “How many times must I tell you? It’s already over.”

hunks.baseline: Crack.
hunks.sol: Crunch.

hunks.baseline: My shoulder blade was crushed. The spear shaft slipped limply from my weakened hand.
hunks.sol: The bones in my shoulder were crushed. The spear shaft slipped limply from my weakened grip.

hunks.baseline: Horrific pain should have followed, but the pain I actually felt was faint.
hunks.sol: Horrific pain should have followed, but what I actually felt was faint and distant.

hunks.baseline: “If you are waiting for help, you are mistaken. The Sichuan Tang Clan will be destroyed. No, perhaps everything is already over by now.”
hunks.sol: “If you’re waiting for help, you’ve miscalculated. The Sichuan Tang Clan will be destroyed. No, it may all be over already.”

hunks.baseline: The shins of both legs, which had been the only parts of me left intact, broke simultaneously. I lost my balance.
hunks.sol: Both shins—the only parts of me still intact—broke at once, and I lost my balance.

hunks.baseline: Ironically, the only reason I was still standing was that the Western Heaven Demon Lord had not let go of me.
hunks.sol: Ironically, the only reason I remained upright was that the Western Heaven Demon Lord had not let go.

hunks.baseline: “Will someone come to your aid as they did in Henan? The Sword Saint, who will only hear the news after half a month? The Sword Saint's successor, who is probably fighting desperately even now? If not…”
hunks.sol: “Who could possibly come to your aid as they did in Henan? The Sword Saint, who won’t hear this news for another half month? The Sword Saint’s successor, who is likely fighting desperately even now? Or perhaps…”

hunks.baseline: Beyond the empty underground prison, destroyed and collapsed by our clash, his gaze settled on a tightly shut iron door.
hunks.sol: Beyond the empty underground prison, shattered and collapsed by our clash, his gaze settled upon a tightly shut iron door.

hunks.baseline: “Your master, who still has not regained consciousness?”
hunks.sol: “Your master, who still hasn’t regained consciousness?”

hunks.baseline: “Nothing will change. Today, the Tang Clan, Qingcheng, and Emei will be destroyed, and all of you…”
hunks.sol: “Nothing will change. Today, the Tang Clan, Qingcheng, and Emei will be destroyed. And all of you…”

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord could not continue.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s words cut off.

hunks.baseline: A sticky liquid of dirt and blood covered his face.
hunks.sol: A sticky mixture of dirt and blood splattered across his face.

hunks.baseline: He clearly had not expected someone whose limbs had already been crushed to do something like this.
hunks.sol: He clearly had not expected someone with all four limbs crushed to do such a thing.
For one fleeting instant, he froze with his hand around my neck.

hunks.baseline: In a moment brief enough to call an instant, I drove my head forward with every ounce of strength I had at the man who had frozen while gripping my neck.
hunks.sol: I drove my head forward with every ounce of strength I had left.

hunks.baseline: With a heavy impact, the Western Heaven Demon Lord's head snapped backward.
hunks.sol: The heavy impact snapped the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s head back.

hunks.baseline: My internal energy had run dry long ago, and my severe Internal Injuries made it difficult to move even a single finger. I did not know where that strength had come from. I did not even know myself.
hunks.sol: My internal energy had run dry long ago, and my severe internal injuries made even lifting a finger difficult. I had no idea where that strength had come from.

hunks.baseline: *I don't have time to think anymore anyway.*
hunks.sol: *It’s not like I have time to think about it anymore.*

hunks.baseline: That had been the last desperate struggle I could manage.
hunks.sol: That had been my final act of defiance.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord stroked his reddened forehead and let out a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord rubbed his reddened forehead and let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: “You really are… a dangerous man.”
hunks.sol: “You truly are… a dangerous man.”

hunks.baseline: I answered in a hazy voice.
hunks.sol: I answered in a faint, unfocused voice.

hunks.baseline: “I should've cracked your skull.”
hunks.sol: “I should’ve cracked your skull.”

hunks.baseline: “If I had not raised my Body-Protecting Qi at the last moment, you might have.”
hunks.sol: “If I hadn’t raised my Body-Protecting Qi at the last moment, you might have.”

hunks.baseline: Unfathomable emotions flickered through the Western Heaven Demon Lord's eyes as he looked at me.
hunks.sol: Unfathomable emotions flickered through the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes as he looked at me.

hunks.baseline: At first glance, they seemed like anger. At the same time, they felt almost like admiration.
hunks.sol: One moment they seemed like anger, the next almost like admiration.

hunks.baseline: But before I could identify those emotions, an unexpected boom rang out.
hunks.sol: Before I could make sense of them, an unexpected roar rang out.

hunks.baseline: The source of the sound was neither me nor the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
hunks.sol: The sound had come from neither me nor the Western Heaven Demon Lord.

hunks.baseline: The underground prison.
hunks.sol: The underground prison itself was trembling.

hunks.baseline: This entire space, stretching for several thousand feet, was trembling. Fist-sized stones fell from the ceiling, and the ground began to split apart.
hunks.sol: The entire vast space, thousands of feet across, shook. Fist-sized stones fell from the ceiling, and cracks spread across the ground.

hunks.baseline: The noise and vibrations soon ceased, but deep furrows appeared between the Western Heaven Demon Lord's brows.
hunks.sol: The noise and tremors soon subsided, but a deep furrow appeared between the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s brows.

hunks.baseline: “…I had better hurry.”
hunks.sol: “…I’d better hurry.”

hunks.baseline: The instant he muttered that while casting a quick glance at the ceiling, the sky and earth flipped.
hunks.sol: The instant he muttered those words and glanced at the ceiling, heaven and earth flipped.

hunks.baseline: Then a small impact reached me through my back.
hunks.sol: A moment later, a slight impact traveled through my back.

hunks.baseline: He had thrown me into the wall.
hunks.sol: He had thrown me against it.

hunks.baseline: I spat out blood, and a calm voice reached my ears.
hunks.sol: As I spat up blood, his calm voice reached my ears.

hunks.baseline: “Sit there for a while. I will be back soon.”
hunks.sol: “Sit there for a while. I’ll be back soon.”

hunks.baseline: “If you are still alive by then, I will take you with me. If you happen to be dead…”
hunks.sol: “If you’re still alive by then, I’ll take you with me. If you happen to be dead…”

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord fell silent briefly before continuing.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord paused before continuing.

hunks.baseline: “That would not be so bad either. You are a dangerous person.”
hunks.sol: “That wouldn’t be so bad either. You’re a dangerous man.”

hunks.baseline: I stretched out my hand with all the strength I had left toward the Western Heaven Demon Lord's retreating back.
hunks.sol: I reached with all the strength I had left toward the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s retreating back.

hunks.baseline: I had to stop him. I had to prevent him from capturing Jeok Cheongang and the Divine Physician.
hunks.sol: I had to stop him. I had to keep him from capturing Jeok Cheongang and the Divine Physician.

hunks.baseline: But not a single part of my body moved as I wanted it to.
hunks.sol: But not a single part of my body would move as I wanted.

hunks.baseline: “Cough. Gaaaagh!”
hunks.sol: “Cough. Bleegh!”

hunks.baseline: Dark-red blood poured from my open mouth.
hunks.sol: Dark-red blood gushed from my open mouth.

hunks.baseline: The clotted pieces mixed into it were…
hunks.sol: The chunks mixed in with it were…

hunks.baseline: *Damn it. Those are pieces of my organs.*
hunks.sol: *Damn it. Pieces of my organs.*

hunks.baseline: It was neither the first time I had seen something like this nor an unexpected sight, but a profound despair weighed down my entire body.
hunks.sol: It was neither my first time seeing such a thing nor an unexpected sight, but crushing despair weighed down my entire body.

hunks.baseline: My limbs were crippled, and I had suffered a fatal Internal Injury.
hunks.sol: Crippled limbs and fatal internal injuries.

hunks.baseline: My mind stood in the Western Heaven Demon Lord's way, but with my crushed arms and legs, I could not move even a single step.
hunks.sol: In my heart, I had already thrown myself into the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s path. But with my arms and legs crushed, I couldn’t take a single step.

hunks.baseline: I raised my head blankly with a groan.
hunks.sol: A groan escaped me as I stared blankly ahead.

hunks.baseline: The corridor where the Western Heaven Demon Lord had disappeared was empty.
hunks.sol: The corridor where the Western Heaven Demon Lord had disappeared stood empty.

hunks.baseline: The place, devastated by our clash, was filled with traces of craters large and small, collapsed walls, and other destruction.
hunks.sol: Devastated by our clash, it was littered with craters large and small, collapsed walls, and countless other scars of battle.

hunks.baseline: The prison where prisoners had still been confined half a day earlier was now strewn with bent bars, fallen rocks, and things like broken chains.
hunks.sol: Inside the cells where prisoners had been confined until half a day ago, bent bars, fallen rocks, and broken chains lay strewn everywhere.

hunks.baseline: At that sight, I realized.
hunks.sol: The sight made me realize it.

hunks.baseline: *It's over.*
hunks.sol: *It’s over.*

hunks.baseline: I had tried to stop him, but I had failed. I had tried to protect them, but I had failed.
hunks.sol: I had tried to stop him, but I couldn’t. I had tried to protect them, but I had failed.

hunks.baseline: The kind of luck we had seen in Henan would not happen again. The Tang Clan, Emei, and Qingcheng were headed for destruction, and Cheongpung could not handle them all alone.
hunks.sol: The kind of luck we’d had in Henan wouldn’t happen again. The Tang Clan, Emei, and Qingcheng were headed for destruction, and Cheongpung couldn’t face their enemies alone.

hunks.baseline: *He'll probably die or be captured.*
hunks.sol: *He’ll probably die or be captured.*

hunks.baseline: I wanted him to run away instead, but that would never happen.
hunks.sol: I wished he would run instead, but that would never happen.

hunks.baseline: That was the kind of person Cheongpung was. Even covered in blood, he would return to the underground prison to save his Benefactor.
hunks.sol: That was the kind of person Cheongpung was. Even drenched in blood, he would return to the underground prison to save his Benefactor.

hunks.baseline: Everything felt like my fault.
hunks.sol: It all felt like my fault.

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung. Jeok Cheongang. Even the Divine Physician, who had been dragged into this mess for no reason and would suffer because of it.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung. Jeok Cheongang. Even the Divine Physician, who had been dragged into this mess through no fault of his own.

hunks.baseline: At least Hyuk Mujin and Gung Gibang had not come with me. That was the only thing I could be grateful for.
hunks.sol: At least I hadn’t brought Hyuk Mujin and Gung Gibang with me.

hunks.baseline: A small vibration reached me along with a roar that seemed to rise from the depths of the earth.
hunks.sol: A slight tremor ran through the ground, accompanied by a roar that seemed to rise from the depths of the earth.

hunks.baseline: The sound announcing the end of the match.
hunks.sol: The bell announcing the end of the match.

hunks.baseline: There had been no need to go twelve rounds like in boxing. I had fallen after only three, and I would probably die soon.
hunks.sol: There had been no need to go twelve rounds like in boxing. I had been knocked out in the third, and I would probably die soon.

hunks.baseline: *I'm sorry. All of you.*
hunks.sol: *I’m sorry. All of you.*

hunks.baseline: The simple rule written in the capsule's instruction manual.
hunks.sol: The capsule’s instruction manual had contained one simple rule.

hunks.baseline: If you die in the Murim, you die in reality, too.
hunks.sol: If I died in Murim, I died in reality too.

hunks.baseline: Everything I had built by traveling between the two worlds was crumbling little by little, just like this underground prison.
hunks.sol: Everything I had built while traveling between those two worlds was crumbling little by little, just like this underground prison.

hunks.baseline: “I didn't think I'd die like this…”
hunks.sol: “I never thought I’d die like this…”

hunks.baseline: My vision blurred. The pain throughout my body and the sounds reaching me through my ears slowly grew distant.
hunks.sol: My vision blurred. The pain throughout my body and the sounds reaching my ears slowly faded away.

hunks.baseline: Then, just as I was about to slip away from all sensation, an old man's face suddenly entered my field of vision.
hunks.sol: Then, just as I was about to slip free of every sensation, an old man’s face suddenly appeared before me.

hunks.baseline: A chain with marks where something had torn it away.
hunks.sol: A chain bearing the marks of having been torn apart.

hunks.baseline: A body so thin that its bones protruded, attached to an unusually tall frame.
hunks.sol: An unusually tall body, so gaunt that every bone stood out.

hunks.baseline: I called out to him in a feeble voice.
hunks.sol: I called to him in a feeble voice.
